fish.name: Minnow
fish.clue: Shoals at the surface wherever the sun is on the water.
fish.note: Crafts into live baitfish.
fish.description: Hardly a mouthful, and always in company. Where these flicker, larger things are watching.

fish.name: Perch
fish.clue: Hunts minnows at the edge of the lilies in daylight.
fish.note: Spines are sharp. Mind your thumb.
fish.description: Banded like shade under reeds, with fins the colour of a warning.

fish.name: Roach
fish.clue: Bites nearly always, if politely asked.
fish.note: A red eye is how you tell it from a rudd.
fish.description: A steady silver fish with a red-rimmed eye. Most anglers start here and some never leave.

fish.name: Rudd
fish.clue: Takes insects off the top on warm afternoons.
fish.note: Upturned mouth, surface feeder.
fish.description: Brass flanks and scarlet fins. It looks up for its dinner, so you see the swirl before the fish.

fish.name: Gudgeon
fish.clue: Noses along the bottom in sandy shallows.
fish.note: One small barbel at each corner of the mouth.
fish.description: A speckled bottom-grubber with one small whisker. It will bite anything, and looks surprised after.

fish.name: Bleak
fish.clue: A flash high in the water, gone in the same moment.
fish.note: Scales were once used to pearl glass beads.
fish.description: Narrow as a blade and just as bright. Shoals scatter at a shadow.

fish.name: Ruffe
fish.clue: A cold-water nibbler on the mud.
fish.note: Coated in slime, all spines.
fish.description: A rough little perch-cousin with a saw for a back and a blue-ringed eye.

fish.name: Bitterling
fish.clue: Shows its colours among the shallows in bright spring sun.
fish.note: Lays its eggs inside mussels. Truly.
fish.description: The smallest jewel in the pond: rose flanks and one aqua stroke.

fish.name: Common carp
fish.clue: Bubbles at the lily roots toward evening.
fish.note: Scale-covered, unlike the mirror.
fish.description: An olive-gold grazer. Slow to take and in no hurry to leave.

fish.name: Whiskered catfish
fish.clue: Feels its way along the bottom once it is dark.
fish.note: Tastes with its whole skin.
fish.description: Flat-headed and mottled, with long whiskers for a night that it cannot see through.

fish.name: Jewel sunfish
fish.clue: Guards a nest in the warm shallows at midsummer.
fish.note: Black ear flag with a red rim.
fish.description: Orange, teal and lemon, as if the pond had been saving up. It will charge your float.

fish.name: Pumpkinseed
fish.clue: Round as a coin, among warm-weather weed.
fish.note: Blue worm-lines all over the cheeks.
fish.description: Blue-scribbled cheeks and a belly like an autumn gourd.

fish.name: Tench
fish.clue: Rises with tiny bubbles at dawn in summer.
fish.note: The old books call it the doctor fish.
fish.description: Thick, dark and slippery, with a tiny red eye and rounded paddles for fins.

fish.name: Bronze bream
fish.clue: Slabs roll at the surface before they feed at dusk.
fish.note: Hump-backed, tall and flat.
fish.description: A tall bronze plate of a fish that comes up like a wet doormat.

fish.name: Silver bream
fish.clue: Mouths bait and spits it out. Wait for it.
fish.note: Larger eye and smaller size than the bronze.
fish.description: Smaller, brighter, warier than its bronze cousin, with an eye too large for its head.

fish.name: Crucian carp
fish.clue: The float barely trembles when these feed.
fish.note: Tolerates water nothing else can.
fish.description: A round, buttery fish with a thumbprint at the tail. Its bite is a rumour.

fish.name: Mirror carp
fish.clue: Great mirrored flanks turn over at summer dusk.
fish.note: Each pattern of large scales is as unique as a face.
fish.description: A deep, humped body with a few huge scales like old coins set in leather.

fish.name: Pike
fish.clue: Hangs in cold water, waiting for something small.
fish.note: Teeth angled backward. Use a wire line.
fish.description: A long-jawed green ambush, freckled in gold. It looks like it has already decided.

fish.name: Weather loach
fish.clue: Stirs only when a storm comes in.
fish.note: Gulps air and swims wildly as pressure falls.
fish.description: Country folk keep one in a jar. It thrashes before rain, and it has never yet been wrong.

fish.name: Lily darter
fish.clue: Perches on lily stems after spring rain.
fish.note: Props itself up on its fins like a small dog.
fish.description: Barely a finger long, barred in moss and lemon, with a cobalt sail for courting.

fish.name: Moth gar
fish.clue: Hangs under the surface after dark, under the moths.
fish.note: Two false eyes on its side, like a moth wing.
fish.description: Long-beaked and armoured, with moth-eye marks along the flank. It strikes at wings on the water.

fish.name: Golden carp
fish.clue: A coin of light moving under still water, clear afternoons only.
fish.note: Keep this one, if only for a while.
fish.description: A carp entirely the colour of late sun. Nobody has seen one young.

fish.name: Albino catfish
fish.clue: A pale shape, deep in the coldest hours.
fish.note: Pink eye, no pigment at all.
fish.description: The same fish as the whiskered cat, minus every trace of night. It should not last a week, and yet.

fish.name: Old Scarjaw pike
fish.clue: Some autumn fogs, ducks vanish from the middle of the pond.
fish.note: Heavy bars, not spots. A very old fish.
fish.description: Barred, black-backed, older than the dock. Its jaw has healed around at least two hooks.

fish.name: Ghost koi
fish.clue: Pale ribbons of fin under spring fog, in the deepest part of the night.
fish.note: Nothing in the pond admits to having seen it.
fish.description: Almost see-through in the lamplight, flowing fins trailing mist. It leaves no wake at all.

fish.name: Moonfin
fish.clue: On the clearest autumn nights, a crescent shows in the water that is not the moon.
fish.note: Every angler knows the story. Almost none have the fish.
fish.description: Sickle fins that glow from their edges inward, and a blue eye-shape on each flank, always looking up.

fish.name: Brook trout
fish.clue: Holds behind stones in cold moving water.
fish.note: Worm tracks on the back, jewels on the side.
fish.description: Worm-tracked and flecked red and gold, with white-edged fins bright as a thumbnail.

fish.name: River minnow
fish.clue: Darts in the shallows where the stream bends.
fish.note: Good bait, if you can stand to.
fish.description: Barred and red-bellied in spring, it hangs in current like a leaf that has changed its mind.

fish.name: Dace
fish.clue: Rises for anything that falls in fast water.
fish.note: Forked tail, narrow head.
fish.description: Small, silver and punctual: it dimples the same patch of water all afternoon.

fish.name: Chub
fish.clue: Lies under overhanging branches and eats whatever drops.
fish.note: Eats almost anything, including small mice.
fish.description: Big-headed and broad-mouthed, with black-edged scales. Bolder than it is clever.

fish.name: Stone loach
fish.clue: Comes out from under stones after dark.
fish.note: Six barbels and not one good idea.
fish.description: A mottled pencil of a fish that lives under rocks, and resents being asked.

fish.name: Bullhead
fish.clue: Hides in gravel where the water runs fast.
fish.note: Wide fins, sits flat as a stone.
fish.description: All head and fan-fins, sitting on gravel like a small angry frog.

fish.name: Spined loach
fish.clue: Buries itself in silt with only its head out.
fish.note: Hides a spine beneath each eye.
fish.description: Sandy and row-spotted, with a tiny folding spine beneath its eye.

fish.name: Bluestone chubling
fish.clue: Comes out in numbers when rain clears.
fish.note: Local to these hills.
fish.description: Slate-blue with aqua flecks: the colour of the wet stones it lives between.

fish.name: Brown trout
fish.clue: Takes in the half-light when the hatch is on.
fish.note: Halos around its red spots.
fish.description: Butter and umber with haloed spots, as handsome as a fish gets without trying.

fish.name: Rainbow trout
fish.clue: Leaps in the sunlit runs.
fish.note: A pink road from gill to tail.
fish.description: Rose-striped and peppered. Strikes, leaps, reconsiders, leaps again.

fish.name: Salmon parr
fish.clue: Young ones in the riffles, barred with thumbprints.
fish.note: Release one, and its children may return.
fish.description: A young fish on its way to somewhere enormous, with a row of dark thumbprints along its side.

fish.name: Barbel
fish.clue: Grubs in fast gravel water through the warm dusk.
fish.note: Underslung mouth, four whiskers.
fish.description: Copper-finned, shovel-snouted and built to hold its place in a flood. It fights the same way.

fish.name: Riffle darter
fish.clue: In spring, the fast water glitters with orange and blue.
fish.note: Courts in the hardest water it can find.
fish.description: An orange and cobalt scrap that rests on stones with its elbows out.

fish.name: Brook lamprey
fish.clue: Night spawners, carrying pebbles in their mouths.
fish.note: No jaw. It holds on with a sucker disc.
fish.description: An ancient, jawless thread with seven gill-holes and no opinions. Older than bones.

fish.name: Grayling
fish.clue: Cold clean water, a sail of violet in the low autumn sun.
fish.note: It smells faintly of thyme.
fish.description: A silver fish carrying an enormous violet sail, edged crimson. The lady of the stream.

fish.name: Kingfisher shiner
fish.clue: A streak of blue over midsummer runs.
fish.note: Beaked, unlike any other shiner.
fish.description: Cobalt above and orange below, with a little beak. It feeds as the bird does, by dropping in.

fish.name: Fallen leaf
fish.clue: Not every leaf on the autumn water is drifting downstream.
fish.note: A single barbel for a leaf stem.
fish.description: A leaf with a midrib, veins, a stem and an appetite. It drifts sideways toward minnows.

fish.name: Ember trout
fish.clue: Late autumn: sparks under the bank, after dark.
fish.note: Warm to the touch. Actually warm.
fish.description: Black and crimson with spots like a fanned coal. The water near it is a little warmer.

fish.name: Moss eel
fish.clue: Slips between the reed roots at dusk.
fish.note: Crosses wet grass on rainy nights.
fish.description: Green as the water it lives in. Its one straight line is the one you pull it in on.

fish.name: Mudfish
fish.clue: Lies buried in soft black peat.
fish.note: Can live in nearly no water.
fish.description: Brown, blunt and patient. Dries out for months, and wakes up cross.

fish.name: Peat perch
fish.clue: Rust-dark hunters of tea-coloured water.
fish.note: Colour comes from the peat it lives in.
fish.description: Stained the colour of bog tea, with spines to match. Bites first.

fish.name: Fen stickleback
fish.clue: Red-chested males guard tiny nests in reed roots.
fish.note: Three spines, no fear.
fish.description: Thumb-sized, red-breasted and three-spined. Picks fights with fish a hundred times its size.

fish.name: Pygmy blackspot
fish.clue: Hovers, barely moving, in the shade of duckweed.
fish.note: Aqua freckles when courting.
fish.description: The smallest fish in the book. Its whole ambition is one black spot on its tail.

fish.name: Reed pipefish
fish.clue: Sways upright among the reeds, pretending to be one.
fish.note: Father carries the young.
fish.description: A jointed yellow straw with a tiny mouth at one end, swaying when the reeds sway.

fish.name: Marsh catfish
fish.clue: Grunts from the shallows on hot nights.
fish.note: Walks on its fins across wet ground.
fish.description: Black and striped, with a skull like a helmet. It breathes air and walks when it has to.

fish.name: Bowfin
fish.clue: A long-backed fish with an eye on its tail.
fish.note: An ocellus to confuse things that bite tails.
fish.description: A living fossil with one long wave of a dorsal fin and a false eye at the tail.

fish.name: Needle gar
fish.clue: Lies like a floating stick at the surface.
fish.note: Beak full of needles.
fish.description: Thin as a walking stick with a beak like tweezers. Armour instead of scales.

fish.name: Lungfish
fish.clue: Rain wakes them from the dried mud.
fish.note: Sleeps a whole dry season in a mud cocoon.
fish.description: Long whip fins like two forgotten legs. Breathes, and sleeps out droughts inside the ground.

fish.name: Shellback mudfish
fish.clue: Hump-backed, plated, slow.
fish.note: Plates are prized for toolmaking.
fish.description: A small armoured loaf, all overlapping plates and a low, offended stare.

fish.name: Reed mudskipper
fish.clue: Something climbs the wet reed bases on sunny days.
fish.note: Eyes on top, sail on its back.
fish.description: Walks on its elbows, eyes on the top of its head, flying a blue sail to anyone who looks.

fish.name: Marsh frogmouth
fish.clue: Sits where it sits. In fog, sometimes, that is your bait.
fish.note: Its mouth is wider than its body.
fish.description: A warty green purse with a door in it. Waits so long that weed grows on it.

fish.name: Ribbon eel
fish.clue: Rain on the marsh, midsummer, past midnight. Violet loops.
fish.note: Holds itself in a knot when resting.
fish.description: A knotted thread of violet with bright aqua rings. Always seems to be untying itself.

fish.name: Rare marsh eel
fish.clue: Autumn rain brings them over the bank.
fish.note: Gold-flecked. Not many left.
fish.description: Char-black with gold flecks, thicker than the moss eel. Bites like a closing door.

fish.name: Bogwisp
fish.clue: Lights on the marsh in autumn fog, past midnight. You have been warned about those.
fish.note: Follow it away from the path at your peril.
fish.description: Glowing green glass with a tail like a whip. Old stories say it leads you away. It does.

fish.name: Smelt
fish.clue: Rises in shoals at first light.
fish.note: Smells faintly of cucumber.
fish.description: Slim and clear with a bright side stripe. Cold water makes it silver and sweet.

fish.name: Vendace
fish.clue: A silver flicker over deep water in the cold months.
fish.note: Upturned chin, small adipose.
fish.description: A pale aqua-backed whitefish of deep cold lakes, once a whole village's winter food.

fish.name: Lake trout
fish.clue: Lives below where the sun gives up.
fish.note: Light spots on dark, the reverse of a brown.
fish.description: Pale spots on grey like snow on rock. It sounds deep and stays there.

fish.name: Alpine sculpin
fish.clue: Sits among the cold stones of the shelf.
fish.note: Grey as its gravel.
fish.description: A spiny-headed grey lump with big fan fins, sitting on the lake floor like it paid for it.

fish.name: Arctic char
fish.clue: Comes shallow at dusk when the ice is thin.
fish.note: Colours deepen as the water chills.
fish.description: A blue-grey back, a belly like a winter sunset, and white-edged fins.

fish.name: Frost perch
fish.clue: Snow on the lake, and something is taking through it.
fish.note: Slightly antifreeze blooded.
fish.description: Pale aqua, frost-speckled, with white-tipped spines. It feels cold even for a fish.

fish.name: Burbot
fish.clue: Spawns under the ice at midwinter, in the dark.
fish.note: The only cod that gave up the sea.
fish.description: Marbled like old cheese, with a single chin barbel and an eel's long tail.

fish.name: Steelhead
fish.clue: Moves in with the rain.
fish.note: A trout that went to see the world.
fish.description: A rainbow trout that has seen the ocean and is unimpressed by you.

fish.name: Red kokanee
fish.clue: In one autumn fortnight, the shallows run scarlet.
fish.note: Hump-backed and hook-jawed at spawning.
fish.description: Crimson with a green head and a hooked jaw, dying on purpose and beautifully.

fish.name: Paddlefish
fish.clue: Something huge moves through, feeding on nothing visible.
fish.note: That paddle senses living things.
fish.description: A shark's body with a canoe paddle on its nose. It filters water with its mouth wide open.

fish.name: Silver ghost char
fish.clue: On still winter nights a pale char rises under the ice.
fish.note: Ribs show faintly through the side.
fish.description: Thin-skinned and moon-pale, with long trailing fins. You can almost count its ribs.

fish.name: Lake sturgeon
fish.clue: Armoured shapes cruise the spring gravel in the evening.
fish.note: Could be a century old.
fish.description: Rows of bony shields and a shovel nose. Older than the ruin, in family and quite possibly in person.

fish.name: Abyss lurker
fish.clue: In the deepest water, a small green light that is not a star.
fish.note: Should not be in a lake. Nobody knows how.
fish.description: All mouth and shadow, with needle teeth and one green lamp on a stalk. Comes up slowly.

fish.name: Starry trout
fish.clue: The lake holds the whole night sky. On clear nights, a few stars leave.
fish.note: No two skies alike.
fish.description: An indigo night sky in the shape of a trout. The stars on it are not any you can name.

fish.name: Deepwater Warden
fish.clue: Fog or snow, the coldest deep of night, the lake floor: it patrols.
fish.note: Do not assume you caught it. It may be allowing this.
fish.description: An armoured giant, plated like a door, bearded with cold whiskers, with one ember for an eye.

fish.name: Blind cavefish
fish.clue: Pale things that turn toward vibration.
fish.note: Eyes skinned over long ago.
fish.description: Flesh-pink, eyeless, unbothered. It feels the world along a line of tiny pits.

fish.name: Cave loach
fish.clue: Long whiskers feel across the silt.
fish.note: Whiskers longer than its head.
fish.description: A bone-coloured line of fish with whiskers doing the work of everything else.

fish.name: Rust carp
fish.clue: Grows where old pipes weep into the water.
fish.note: Eats the rust itself.
fish.description: Rivet-spotted and pitted, coloured exactly like the pipes it grazes on.

fish.name: Drain eel
fish.clue: Sleeps coiled in culverts.
fish.note: Yellow eye, ring-marked body.
fish.description: Black, ringed in steel-grey and curled like the pipe it lives in.

fish.name: Tallow catfish
fish.clue: A waxy shape along the old tank wall.
fish.note: Its fat burns, and it was once used for lamps.
fish.description: Wax-yellow and blind, soft as candle fat. Workers once fed them for the lamp oil.

fish.name: Echo fish
fish.clue: Tap the wall and something taps back.
fish.note: It answers sounds with a little drum of its bladder.
fish.description: Grey, with ripple rings across its side, like something you dropped in the water a long time ago.

fish.name: Coin carp
fish.clue: Someone threw wishes down here once. Something ate them.
fish.note: The scales are almost round enough to spend.
fish.description: Stamped all over in dark rings like old money, and as heavy as it looks.

fish.name: Pale olm
fish.clue: A pink finger with little legs, deep under everything. Not a fish, and it is in the book anyway.
fish.note: Lives a hundred years. May wait ten without food.
fish.description: Pink gills like a flower, tiny legs, no eyes to speak of. An amphibian that never agreed to grow up.

fish.name: Ink lamprey
fish.clue: Black water that is black for a reason.
fish.note: It stains your hands for a week.
fish.description: A dripping ink-black loop with a line of faint gill-lights and one pale eye.

fish.name: Lantern tetra
fish.clue: Tiny lights turn together where the dark is deepest.
fish.note: Keeps its light even when dried.
fish.description: An indigo fish with a row of cyan lamps. A shoal looks like a small town seen from far off.

fish.name: Spore gourami
fish.clue: Feeds where luminous fungus drops into the water.
fish.note: Long feeler fin, tasting the water ahead.
fish.description: Fungus-green, glowing in patches, with one long feeler it holds out like a candle.

fish.name: Silt ray
fish.clue: The silt floor has an outline. It moved.
fish.note: Tail spine. Careful.
fish.description: A flat disc of silt with spots for stars and a whip for a tail. Never a fish you notice first.

fish.name: Glassscale
fish.clue: On quiet nights the reservoir water has a part with a fish-shaped absence.
fish.note: You can see its heart beat.
fish.description: A body like poured glass, with spine, ribs and a small ember of a heart all on show.

fish.name: The Hollow Serpent
fish.clue: Something ate through the bottom of the reservoir. It has not stopped. Bring your strongest line and do not go in autumn alone.
fish.note: It has ribs on the outside.
fish.description: A coiled thing all black, with bone showing in rungs through its back and a thin cold light running down the middle.

fish.name: Blossom dace
fish.clue: On the day the rowan blooms, petals on the water sometimes swim.
fish.note: Only on the Awakening.
fish.description: A dace with petal-pink fins that rises to the blossom falling on the pond, and only then.

fish.name: Glowfin
fish.clue: When the pond is full of fireflies, something underneath answers them.
fish.note: Only on the Firefly Evening.
fish.description: A slim dark fish whose fins carry a row of soft green lights, blinking in time with the fireflies above.

fish.name: Tide lantern
fish.clue: Under the clear ice, some of the lights are moving.
fish.note: Only beneath the Silent Tide.
fish.description: A fish with a lamp of its own, drifting between the drowned windows as if it still had somewhere to be.

fish.name: Hush eel
fish.clue: Something long moves through the drowned streets without a sound.
fish.note: Only beneath the Silent Tide.
fish.description: A pale eel that lives in the drowned streets and makes no ripple at all, even when caught.

pond.name: Woodland pond
pond.description: Still, lily-edged water beside the camp. The platform reaches the deep heart of it.

stream.name: Forest stream
stream.description: Bright, broken water over stones through the birches. Everything here holds against the current.

marsh.name: Peat marsh
marsh.description: Tea-black water under cattails and drowned snags. Most of what lives here can breathe air.

lake.name: Alpine lake
lake.description: A cold turquoise bowl beneath snow peaks. The shelf drops away very suddenly.

tide.name: Beneath the Silent Tide

requires.text: The ice is ordinary ice tonight.

tide.description: The ice is clear as glass. Below it, the drowned town keeps its lights on.

reservoir.name: Sunken reservoir

requires.text: An old iron door, locked. Somewhere there is a key.

reservoir.description: A flooded brick vault below the ruin. It has never heard of the seasons.
